clue.text: Like producing flowers soon for a friend?

definitions.meaning: read whimsically as bud plus -dy, an adjective for a plant full of buds about to open

explanation.surface: Someone wonders whether a gift of soon-to-bloom flowers suits a friend.
explanation.definitionFit: Buddy is an informal word for a close pal, and the jokey reading treats it as an adjective formed from bud.

clue.text: Trees as coastal features say?

indicators.note: say signals that we want a word pronounced like the coastal one

parts.note: sandy shores along the sea's edge

explanation.surface: A question whether trees might count as seaside landmarks.
explanation.definitionFit: Beech is a common broad-leaved tree, so the plural names a stand of them.

clue.text: Raised pulse might result from this?

definitions.text: Raised pulse might result from this?

indicators.note: the clue words are what a rearrangement of the solution would yield, so they are the fodder shuffled back

explanation.surface: Annoyance quickens the heartbeat, a physiological observation.
explanation.walkthrough: A reverse anagram: rearranging the answer's letters gives RAISED PULSE, and the whole clue also describes what anger does to the heart.
explanation.definitionFit: Being annoyed or angered is a classic cause of the heart racing.

clue.text: When out of whiskey wild-eyed crazy gave in

indicators.note: crazy suggests letters going wild and being jumbled
out of means the letter is lost from the hyphenated word

parts.note: Whiskey is W in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A wild-eyed drinker, run dry of whiskey, finally surrenders.
explanation.walkthrough: Removing W leaves ILDEYED, which 'crazy' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: To yield is to surrender or submit, so the past tense matches conceded.

clue.text: Genuine gold article, not 'one carat'

parts.note: Au is the chemical symbol for gold
the definite article
n't is the contracted form of not
I is the Roman numeral for one
c is an abbreviation for carat

explanation.surface: A jeweller insists a gold item is real, while denying it is one carat.
explanation.walkthrough: The quote marks make 'not one carat' look like a description; instead it is N'T, I and C in turn.
explanation.definitionFit: Something authentic is real and not fake, exactly what genuine means.

clue.text: A girl's love can burst into an acceptance for troubles

parts.note: Ann is a girl's name
love is zero in tennis scoring, the letter O

indicators.note: into means the shuffled letters go inside the word of agreement

parts.note: yes is a word of acceptance

indicators.note: burst signals that the letters of can are broken up and rearranged

explanation.surface: A girl's affection might suddenly turn into her saying yes to a proposal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'burst' is the anagram signal and 'into' the insertion; 'A girl' is Ann, and the stray 'an' merely links.
explanation.definitionFit: Annoyances are irritations or bothers, and troubles here is a plural noun of that sort.

clue.text: Sailor joins navy in body of water

parts.note: tar is an old word for a sailor

explanation.surface: A seaman enlists in the fleet and ends up afloat.
explanation.definitionFit: A tarn is a small mountain lake, a body of water in northern English hills.

clue.text: One of the tympani tried with lid removed — strange

indicators.note: in a down clue the lid is the top letter, which is taken away

parts.note: a judge heard a case means tried it in court
rum is a British word for odd or peculiar

explanation.surface: Someone tested the kettledrums with the cover off and found the sound odd.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tympani' suggests orchestral drums, but a tympanum is also the membrane in the ear.
explanation.definitionFit: The tympanum, or tympanic membrane, is the anatomical name for that membrane in the ear.

clue.text: Rocky outcrop beside river

parts.note: to can mean next to or against, as in face to face

explanation.surface: A rocky crag stands by a stream.
explanation.definitionFit: A tor is a hill topped with bare rock, common on Dartmoor in south-west England.

clue.text: Admit grift if heists regularly ignored

parts.note: grift is a swindle, a con

indicators.note: every other letter of if heists is skipped, keeping the remainder

explanation.surface: A swindler owns up, provided the robberies are routinely overlooked.
explanation.definitionFit: To confess is to own up to or acknowledge something, matching admit.

clue.text: Essentially fear more forbidding Asian

indicators.note: essentially points at the essence, the central letters of fear

parts.note: sterner means stricter, more forbidding

explanation.surface: A warning that fear bans something, phrased like an odd slogan.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone from the East, from an Oriental country, is an Asian person in this loose sense.

clue.text: Show repeats about arguing off and on

definitions.note: read as a show that repeats, a single broadcast shown again

parts.note: re means about or concerning

indicators.note: off and on means take the letters intermittently, every other one

explanation.surface: A television show keeps rehashing an on-off quarrel.
explanation.definitionFit: A rerun is a broadcast screened again, a programme that is repeated.

clue.text: Country dance includes one in ancient festival

indicators.note: includes means the dance's letters wrap round the rest

parts.note: hay, or hey, is an old country dance

indicators.note: in places the numeral inside the word for old

parts.note: ancient means old
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A rustic dance features at an age-old celebration.
explanation.definitionFit: A holiday was originally a holy day, a festival or feast day.

clue.text: Fancy lecture about Newton

indicators.note: about here means going around the physics letter

parts.note: to orate is to speak pompously, to lecture
N is the symbol for the newton, the unit of force

explanation.surface: An elaborate talk on Isaac Newton.
explanation.definitionFit: Ornate means elaborately decorated, which is what fancy means as an adjective.

clue.text: The output of 23 16 26 11 et al and such stuff

definitions.meaning: the cross-referenced entries are surnames or first names of famous jazz musicians: a saxophonist, a trumpeter, a drummer and a singer
an idiom for everything of that sort, used at the end of a list

explanation.surface: A list of jazz greats' work, with a dismissive wave at the rest.
explanation.walkthrough: The cross-references are Wayne, Davis, Blakey and Billie: their music is jazz in its entirety.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase literally sums up the musicians' collective music and idiomatically means and so on.

clue.text: Appraisal idiots, people in the core of Ofsted

parts.note: asses are fools

indicators.note: in places the word for people inside the middle letters
core means the central letters of the inspectorate's name

parts.note: men as a general word for persons

explanation.surface: A school inspection report calls the staff fools.
explanation.walkthrough: Ofsted is England's schools inspectorate; its middle two letters are ST.
explanation.definitionFit: An assessment is an evaluation or judgment, the same as an appraisal.

clue.text: Reputations of understudies taking up golf

indicators.note: taking up means absorbing, so the golf letter goes inside

parts.note: stand-ins are substitute performers
Golf is G in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Backup actors gain stature by starting golf.
explanation.definitionFit: A person's standing is their status or reputation; the plural matches.

clue.text: Look pleased after cycling — it's a long way

indicators.note: cycling means the first letter rides round to the back

parts.note: to smile is to look happy

explanation.surface: A happy cyclist after a big ride notes the distance covered.
explanation.definitionFit: Miles are units of distance, and many of them make a long way.

clue.text: A noble matter

definitions.meaning: a European aristocrat ranking with an earl
to be important, as in every vote matters

explanation.surface: A nobleman's business, stated tersely.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names a titled continental aristocrat and, as a verb, means to be significant.

clue.text: Camp bed set above a lake

indicators.note: in a down clue set above puts the bed first

parts.note: a cot is a small bed
Erie is one of the Great Lakes

explanation.surface: A camp bed pitched beside a lake shore.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Camp bed' reads as one item, but 'Camp' is the definition, a faction or clique.
explanation.definitionFit: A coterie is a clique or exclusive circle, as a camp is a faction sharing views.

clue.text: A foot preserved in vitro — cheek!

indicators.note: preserved in suggests something kept inside the phrase, letters held within

explanation.surface: Someone protests at a foot kept in a test tube.
explanation.walkthrough: 'foot' means a metrical unit in poetry, not a body part.
explanation.definitionFit: A trochee is a metrical unit of one stressed then one unstressed syllable.

clue.text: Look at what cat's got — they might be fluttering

parts.note: to eye is to look at
the cat-o'-nine-tails, a whip, has lashes

explanation.surface: Watching a cat that has something, while lashes flutter flirtatiously.
explanation.definitionFit: Lashes fringing the eye are what flutter in a flirtatious glance.

clue.text: Revelled drunkenly but not caught up

indicators.note: but not means leaving out the cricket letter

parts.note: to carouse is to drink and revel noisily
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: A partygoer drank hard but wasn't caught out.
explanation.definitionFit: Up can mean excited or stirred, as in the crowd was up for it.

clue.text: Sudden rush on the lines for period of consultation

indicators.note: in a down clue on means placed after

parts.note: a surge is a sudden powerful rush
Ry is short for railway, the lines

explanation.surface: A sudden influx of traffic on the railway.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain a doctor's or MP's surgery is the session when they see the public.
explanation.definitionFit: A British surgery is the session when a doctor or MP sees people.

clue.text: Turkey's capital city recalled seismic shock

parts.note: TR is Turkey's international country code

indicators.note: recalled means called back, so the city's letters run in reverse

parts.note: Rome, capital of Italy

explanation.surface: Turkey's capital remembers an earthquake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Turkey's capital' looks like Ankara or a first letter T, but Turkey gives its code TR and 'capital city' is Rome, reversed by 'recalled'.
explanation.definitionFit: A tremor is a slight earthquake, the shaking of the ground.

clue.text: More brusque out of anguish or terror

indicators.note: out of indicates letters taken from within the phrase

explanation.surface: A person becomes curt from distress or fear.
explanation.definitionFit: Being short with someone means curt, so the comparative is more curt.

clue.text: Sushi ingredient eaten by senorita

indicators.note: eaten by means swallowed inside the Spanish word

explanation.surface: A young Spanish woman eats sushi.
explanation.definitionFit: Nori is dried seaweed wrapped round sushi rolls.

clue.text: Fish in a butt

definitions.meaning: a freshwater fish of the carp family
slang for the end of a cannabis joint or cigarette

explanation.surface: A fish swims inside a water butt.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names a carp-family freshwater fish and, in slang, the stub end of a joint.

clue.text: Leave just the bottom half in painting

indicators.note: in a down clue the bottom half is the latter half of the word for leave, the top half going

parts.note: depart means leave

explanation.surface: An instruction to keep only the lower half of a picture.
explanation.definitionFit: Painting is one of the fine arts, a visual creative craft.

clue.text: Exaggerate aspect of proceedings from Lord's gallery?

definitions.text: aspect of proceedings from Lord's gallery?
definitions.meaning: the state of an over, six balls bowled, as watched from the stands at the cricket ground

explanation.surface: A spectator at Lord's might overdo the commentary.
explanation.walkthrough: Lord's is the London cricket ground; an over is a set of six deliveries. 'Lord's' tempts toward the House of Lords.
explanation.definitionFit: To overstate is to exaggerate or put something too strongly.

clue.text: Emir texts with new order for zealot

indicators.note: new order means the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An emir sends messages instructing a fanatic.
explanation.definitionFit: A zealot is a fanatic, someone holding radical views.

clue.text: Bewildering signs of sleep during course of home improvements?

indicators.note: during means within, so the sleep letters sit inside

parts.note: DIY, do-it-yourself, is home improvement work
ZZ are the letters drawn for snoring in cartoons

explanation.surface: Someone nods off midway through a confusing renovation.
explanation.definitionFit: Dizzy can describe what causes giddiness, as in dizzy heights, so it means confusing or bewildering.
